findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_geometry_catalog · Private data: loc_id_info, list_reference_systems, get_volcanic_activity, get_tsunami_events · Public sink: query_dataset · Destructive: estimate_geometry_package, estimate_conversion_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_geometry_catalog · Private data: loc_id_info, list_reference_systems, get_volcanic_activity, get_tsunami_events · Public sink: query_dataset · Destructive: estimate_geometry_package, estimate_conversion_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
